top_signals.title: BlackRock’s Koesterich Sees Energy Stocks as Best Portfolio Diversifier
top_signals.summary: Russ Koesterich, Global Allocation Fund portfolio manager at BlackRock, says bonds are not working as a hedge as yields on 30-year US Treasuries rose to the highest since 2007 this week. He talks about the factors he sees driving long-dated bonds and why he doesn’t see $100 oil derailing the US economic expansion. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Germany Sells 30-Year Bonds at the Highest Yield Since 2011
top_signals.summary: Germany’s borrowing costs hit a 15-year high in a major sale of long-dated bonds, as investors fret about rising government debt and persistent inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: India Challenges US Quartz Tariffs With WTO Consultation Bid
top_signals.summary: India has sought consultations with the US at the World Trade Organization over tariffs imposed by the White House on some quartz products, adding another point of friction between the two countries as they remain without a trade deal.
